ideas.pitch: An automated platform for detecting and extracting concealed payloads hidden within multi-layered steganographic images and audio files using custom LSB and frequency domain analysis.
ideas.title: StegoNet
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages technical difficulty in data forensics and steganography, directly targeting the core technical domains of the CTF competition where deep binary or media analysis is heavily rewarded.

ideas.pitch: A localized intelligence-gathering tool that aggregates metadata, EXIF details, and open-source social footprint footprints to construct visual relationship graphs for CTF-style investigations.
ideas.title: OSINT-Trace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies graph intelligence patterns seen in winning AML and investigation platforms to solve complex OSINT correlation puzzles efficiently during time-sensitive CTF events.

ideas.pitch: An interactive vulnerability scanner and solver toolkit for weakened cryptographic primitives, including custom RSA implementations, XOR cipher patterns, and faulty padding schemes.
ideas.title: CryptoBreak
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuine algorithmic depth by automating mathematical attacks on cryptographic puzzles, giving competitors a massive speed advantage during live flag submissions.

ideas.pitch: A static analysis assistant that uncovers hidden symbols, strings, and control-flow flattening in compiled binaries to accelerate reverse engineering challenges.
ideas.title: BinaryDeobfuscate
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on hardcore systems engineering and automated decompilation workflows, directly mirroring the complex security insights tooling that won Microsoft's Global Intern Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A rapid memory dump parsing utility that uses heuristic regex patterns and symbol extraction to locate injected DLLs and hidden flags within volatile RAM images.
ideas.title: MemoryForensics-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines robust digital forensics tool integration with streamlined anomaly detection, offering judges an immediately practical tool for solving memory-based CTF challenges.
